notes: Behavioral evals for the acceptance-pipeline-kit integration. Source-surface cases run with `run_behavioral_evals.py`; live cases run with `--live --kit-dir <acceptance-pipeline-kit>`.

evals.prompt: Inspect the Shepherd skill and prove role ownership for executable acceptance: implementers own normal acceptance pipeline components for their slice, the architect owns acceptance-spec mutation hardening, refactorer and coordinator do not run mutation, and the workflow points at the real acceptance_pipeline.py / validate_acceptance_mutation.py scripts.
evals.expected_output: SKILL.md, prompts, and references wire the kit: implementer runs normal acceptance, architect runs acceptance-spec mutation and blocks on survivors/errors then dispatches implementer repair, refactorer excludes mutation, and the mechanics live in references/acceptance-mutation.md keyed to killed/survived/error.

evals.prompt: Run the real kit pipeline on a fixture where every acceptance-spec mutation is killed.
evals.expected_output: Normal acceptance passes and acceptance_pipeline.py mutation returns PASS with survived=0 errors=0; the milestone gate is satisfiable.

evals.prompt: Run the real kit pipeline on a fixture whose handler ignores an example value so generated tests still pass after a value is mutated.
evals.expected_output: acceptance_pipeline.py mutation returns BLOCK with survived>0, records the surviving mutation paths, and the gate exits non-zero so the architect requests focused implementer repair instead of approving.

evals.prompt: Run the real kit pipeline on a fixture with no executable examples while mutations are required.
evals.expected_output: acceptance_pipeline.py mutation returns BLOCK because zero mutations executed: the examples cannot prove behaviour-relevant binding.

evals.prompt: Run the real kit pipeline on a fixture where the acceptance pipeline itself fails (broken handler import) while normal acceptance would otherwise pass.
evals.expected_output: acceptance_pipeline.py mutation returns BLOCK with errors>0, treating the mutation error as unverifiable infrastructure rather than passing evidence.
